title: Savoy Farmer Dies at Age 88
text:
J. W. WOODS.

Savoy Farmer Dies at Age 88

SAVOY.—A retired farmer, J. W. Woods, 88, died at 7 a. m. Sunday at his home here. He had been an invalid for 10 years. Funeral services were to be held at 2:30 p. m. Monday at the Baptist church with the Rev. Bob Cates, Methodist pastor, conducting. Interment was to be in Oak Hill cemetery with Glen Earnheart of Whitewright directing.

Pallbearers were to be H. F. Bomar, Earl Blakey, H. T. Blakey, Joe Parkhill, A. R. Deberry and S. R. Large.

Born May 26, 1856, in Tennessee, he was the son of Mr. and Mrs. J. W. Woods. He was married to Miss Jennie Worley of Corsicana, coming to Texas in early manhood. He had lived at Ector and Savoy the past 30 years.

Survivors include his wife and three sons, O. W. Woods and Clyde Woods of Houston, J. D. Woods of Savoy; one daughter, Mrs. A. L. Furr of Houston; 17 grandchildren and 8 great grandchildren.
